desc:
Run your own K-pop store and collect photocards of your favorite idols! 💜

How To Play:
💿 Open packs and pull rare cards
🎀 Fill your binder and decorate it
🛍️ Stock shelves and ring up fans at your register
🏏 Catch thieves before they run off with your stock
👥 Hire staff to help run your store
🏪 Expand to new floors and decorate
🤝 Co-op: run your store with a friend
🔄 Trade cards with friends

👯 +10% Cash for every friend in your server!
🎁 Code: KPOPLAUNCH for $7,500 Cash + 2 Premium Packs!
👉 Open the Shop and scroll down to Codes to claim it

👍 Like + Favorite for more updates!
